description: A comprehensive privacy policy is not accessible to data subjects. The policy should consolidate all required transparency information in an easily accessible location.
applicability: Applicable to all organizations processing personal data. The privacy policy should be prominently linked and available across all data collection touchpoints.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of website and application for privacy policy presence and accessibility. Verify policy is findable, current, and complete.

sources.title: GDPR - Regulation (EU) 2016/679
sources.section: Chapter III - Rights of the Data Subject
